conversation.content: thank you for calling Abita Eye Group, this is David, how can I help you?
I was calling about the Spring Hill location.
yeah I can help with that.  What were you needing to know about the Spring Hill location?
Is there a pediatric ophthalmologist there?

yes, we do. Dr. Bach sees pediatric patients at Spring Hill -- he handles pediatrics, adult strabismus, and double vision.  Just so you know, his schedule is limited and only at Spring Hill a couple times per month, so availability may be several weeks out.
let me check on that.  Before I look, what's the reason for the visit?
Um, my child is seeing colored spots.
ok, and how old is your child?
